meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 安装后 Claude 会多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里当前可用的本地模型,以及把提示词发给指定模型并取回它的回复。Claude 仍负责编排,模型由 Atomic Chat 桌面端管理。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 用 Atomic Chat 的本地模型回答或生成内容时,它会先列出可用模型,再调用指定模型。前提是本机 Atomic Chat 已开启本地 API 服务(端口 1337)。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 先列出模型,再生成回答

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 现在可用的模型
say.note: 查看当前可用的模型 ID

say.text: 用 atomic_chat_generate 让本地模型回答:你好
say.note: 模型 ID 要与列表结果一致

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains two tools: it can list the local models available in the Atomic Chat desktop app, and send a prompt to a chosen model and return its reply. Claude stays the orchestrator; models are managed in the Atomic Chat UI.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to answer or generate with Atomic Chat's local models, it lists available models then calls the one you name. Requires Atomic Chat running with its Local API Server on port 1337.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
List the models currently available in atomic chat
Use atomic_chat_generate to have a local model answer: hi
say_en.note: Model ID must match the list
